name: exchange-online-distribution-group-external-sender-audit
title: Exchange Online Distribution Group External Sender Audit
shortDescription: Audits distribution groups that allow messages from external or unauthenticated senders and exports the results to CSV.
longDescription: Connects to Exchange Online with certificate-based app-only authentication, inventories distribution groups, identifies groups that permit external senders, and produces an audit report with summary statistics.
